title: A 90s Village Love Story 🚲🌧️ pure nostalgia #shorts

segments.moment_description: Morning: the couple rides a bicycle together along the misty riverside
Midday: a playful moment at the village hand pump, filling the brass pot
Afternoon: a tender rest by the lotus pond, feet dipped in the water
The monsoon breaks - they run laughing through the rain to shelter
Dusk: walking home side by side with the bicycle and a lantern, fireflies out
